title: MASSIVE Traffic Update! New real-world airline schedules inside MSFS
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest releases from VA Systems so you can skip the menu guessing and know exactly where to point your nose cone next.

We divide the breakdown into two major categories:
✈️ International Fleet Schedules: A deep dive into the brand-new Summer 2026 real-world route schedules for major global carriers. We breakdown the specific route profiles and liveries included for Air New Zealand (ANZ), Delta Air Lines (DAL), Lufthansa (DLH), Japan Airlines (JAL), and EgyptAir (MSR). Note: Livery availability depends directly on the base aircraft you already own!
🌍 Global Hub Traffic Overhauls: A close look at massive operational schedule injections for the world's busiest airspaces. We examine what these overhauls add to major international hubs, including O.R. Tambo International (Johannesburg), Los Angeles International (LAX), Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), São Paulo/Guarulhos International (GRU), and Hong Kong International (HKG). Learn how these bundles combine multiple airline routes into unified hub profiles to completely refresh your departure environments.

Whether you choose to map out longhaul Pacific routes with Japan Airlines and Air New Zealand or inject highly accurate summer airline traffic directly into major global airports like Los Angeles, Paris, or Hong Kong, VA Systems has provided an absolute massive playground for airline enthusiasts this week. 

Let me know in the comments: are you choosing the heavy airliners or exploring historic parts first? Smash the like button, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
